tr.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,
tr.pickthall: When the event befalleth -

tr.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
tr.pickthall: There is no denying that it will befall -

tr.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
tr.pickthall: Abasing (some), exalting (others);

tr.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
tr.pickthall: When the earth is shaken with a shock

tr.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
tr.pickthall: And the hills are ground to powder

tr.sahih: And become dust dispersing,
tr.pickthall: So that they become a scattered dust,

tr.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:
tr.pickthall: And ye will be three kinds:

tr.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr.pickthall: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

tr.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
tr.pickthall: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?

tr.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
tr.pickthall: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:

tr.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
tr.pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh

tr.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
tr.pickthall: In gardens of delight;

tr.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples
tr.pickthall: A multitude of those of old

tr.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,
tr.pickthall: And a few of those of later time.

tr.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],
tr.pickthall: On lined couches,

tr.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.
tr.pickthall: Reclining therein face to face.

tr.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.
tr.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths

tr.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
tr.pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring

tr.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
tr.pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,

tr.sahih: And fruit of what they select
tr.pickthall: And fruit that they prefer

tr.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
tr.pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.

tr.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr.pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,

tr.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
tr.pickthall: Like unto hidden pearls,

tr.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.
tr.pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.text: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

tr.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
tr.pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination

tr.sahih: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
tr.pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.

tr.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr.pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

tr.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.
tr.pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees

tr.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].
tr.pickthall: And clustered plantains,

tr.sahih: And shade extended.
tr.pickthall: And spreading shade,

tr.sahih: And water poured out
tr.pickthall: And water gushing,

tr.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
tr.pickthall: And fruit in plenty

tr.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
tr.pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,

tr.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.
tr.pickthall: And raised couches;

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation

tr.sahih: And made them virgins,
tr.pickthall: And made them virgins,

tr.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
tr.pickthall: Lovers, friends,

tr.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]
tr.pickthall: For those on the right hand;

tr.sahih: A company of the former peoples
tr.pickthall: A multitude of those of old

tr.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.
tr.pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.

tr.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
tr.pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?

tr.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
tr.pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water

tr.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,
tr.pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,

tr.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.
tr.pickthall: Neither cool nor refreshing.

tr.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
tr.pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury

tr.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,
tr.pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.

ayahs.text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr.pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,

tr.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
tr.pickthall: And also our forefathers?

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time

tr.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
tr.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.

tr.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
tr.pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,

tr.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
tr.pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

tr.sahih: And filling with it your bellies
tr.pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;

tr.sahih: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.
tr.pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,

tr.sahih: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
tr.pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.

tr.sahih: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
tr.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.

tr.sahih: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
tr.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?

tr.sahih: Have you seen that which you emit?
tr.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?

tr.sahih: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
tr.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?

ayahs.text: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

tr.sahih: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
tr.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,

ayahs.text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
tr.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?

tr.sahih: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
tr.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?

tr.sahih: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
tr.pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?

ayahs.text: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
tr.pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
tr.pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!

tr.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
tr.pickthall: Nay, but we are deprived!

tr.sahih: And have you seen the water that you drink?
tr.pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?

ayahs.text: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
tr.pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?

ayahs.text: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

words.gloss: then why are you not grateful
then why are you not grateful

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
tr.pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?

tr.sahih: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
tr.pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;

ayahs.text: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
tr.pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?

words.gloss: for the wayfarers in the desert

tr.sahih: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
tr.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.

tr.sahih: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
tr.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
tr.pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
tr.pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an

tr.sahih: In a Register well-protected;.
tr.pickthall: In a Book kept hidden

tr.sahih: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
tr.pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,

tr.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
tr.pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,

tr.sahih: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
tr.pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood?

tr.sahih: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
tr.pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

tr.sahih: And you are at that time looking on -
tr.pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking

ayahs.text: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
tr.pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -

tr.sahih: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
tr.pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),

tr.sahih: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
tr.pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?

tr.sahih: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],
tr.pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,

tr.sahih: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: And if he was of the companions of the right,
tr.pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,

tr.sahih: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
tr.pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
tr.pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,

tr.sahih: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
tr.pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water

tr.sahih: And burning in Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is certain truth.

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
